post.title: Mattermost wants $10 a seat. Antimatter is the free fork.
post.caption: Fresh grudges against a per-seat chat licence, a car-spotting app that costs too much and paying for a job you do twice a year, each replaced by someone annoyed enough to build the free version.

segments.quote: paywalling previously available features, putting arbitrary limits that previously didn't exist

cues.cap: Mattermost wants $10 a user a month
cues.say: Mattermost wants ten dollars a user a month

cues.cap: to chat on your own server.

segments.gripe: The car-spotting app costs too much.
segments.quote: Since the actual app is too expensive.

cues.cap: pay an app to name it.
“Since the actual app is too expensive.”
cues.say: [sarcastic] Since the actual app is too expensive.
[quick] So: Garage Dex. Built with Claude.

segments.gripe: Renaming software wants a licence for a twice-a-year job.
segments.quote: I couldn’t justify buying dedicated software for it.

cues.say: [quick] So: Rename Tools. In a tab.

cues.cap: All built out of pure spite.
